decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal by reason of its size, position and appearance will result in an unacceptable loss of outlook, sunlight and privacy to neighboring properties. The proposal is therefore contrary to ENV 1.1 (All New Development), H 3.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development plan and ENV B1.1 (New Development) and H 6.4 (Housing Extensions) of the revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan and associated Supplementary Planning Guidance.

Condition : 2 - The proposal by reason of its size and position represents an overdevelopment of the site and will have an adverse impact on the visual amenity of the area and is therefore contrary to Policy ENV1.1 (All New Development) of the adopted Unitary development Plan and ENV B1.1 (New Development) of the revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension to existing dwellinghouse.
